whenToUse: Long texts read to the end, such as articles or guides.
Mobile, where the scrollbar is hard to see.
Knowing how much is left helps reading.
whenNotToUse: Screens with no fixed end, such as lists or feeds.
Places where it could be confused with page loading (keep it apart from a top loading bar).
accessibility: The bar is a visual aid, so it's aria-hidden; the scrollbar and document structure already give the position.
Only transform changes, so it stays light while scrolling.
Register the scroll listener as passive.
The text area takes focus and can be scrolled with the keyboard.
